edit.description: `dangling_mention` (:2308) matches `NodeSpecies::Member | NodeSpecies::EmbeddedLeaf => "member"`, so a mention to a leaf address that resolves against no embedded leaf reports `resolves to no member in the discovered corpus`. Give the leaf species its own word in `resolves_against`, and correct the doc comment at :2305, which enumerates only member and requirement. One word covers both sub-cases truthfully — the host member present with no such leaf, and no such host — so no two-case split is wanted. `render_node`, `mention_finding` and `ambiguous_mention` do not move.

Pin the leaf grain beside `a_dangling_mention_from_a_nested_source_names_it_by_its_whole_address` (:1918): a mention whose target is a leaf address under a nested member that exists must report at leaf grain and must not claim the member is missing. No existing assertion in this file reads the dangling-mention wording at leaf grain.

summary: A dangling mention to a leaf address reports `resolves to no member`, sending a reader after a member that exists — only the leaf inside it is missing.

tests.asserts: a mention from a member to `<host>/<kind>/<key>/<child>` whose host nested member is composed but carries no such leaf fires one `graph.route` finding naming the target at leaf grain, and the message does not say the target resolves to no member

acceptance: `cargo test` green including the new leaf-grain pin, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean, `cargo fmt --all --check` clean. No snapshot moves: `rg 'resolves to no member'` finds no snapshot or fixture pinning the mention wording — examples/base-harness/README.md carries one instance and its target (`source:main`) is member-grain, unchanged.
notes: Swept from 54b32f06's own comment ('the wording the gate has always used'): `node_species` unified the classifier and this is the one consumer still flattening a leaf into a member. `read_verbs.rs:686` pins `explain` narrating the same target as `leaf ...`, so gate and read verb disagree at leaf grain — the `per` section forbids that. `resolve_leaf` (read.rs:1496) also fails with the host member present, so the message is false there, not merely coarse. scoped at 7e4d7849
